review.gallery: Nine images from the David-specific 25-page developer brochure. Excluded generic lifestyle photos, overlay graphics and mixed Al Jaddaf community context.
review.location: Verified the David-specific map and travel panel in the Mitchell’s factsheet mirror. Seven estimates retained, including the single 5-minute grouped waterfront reference. Omitted the uncorroborated Dubai Parks and Resorts figure.
review.floorPlans: 64 complete residential sheets and six floor plates retained, with physical page and owner references. Read the visible title-block areas because the PDF maps some text to private-use glyphs. Unit 1111 / 1211 / 1311 restored from the visible panel on page 29. The four representative brochure types on pages 22–23 match the plan pack and do not add unique layouts.

unavailable: Exact entrance coordinates, verified travel distances and individual shop area schedules were not established.
